43212-fairy-tales-from-spain.title: From Spain
43212-fairy-tales-from-spain.creator: J. Munoz Escomez
43212-fairy-tales-from-spain.description: A book by J. Munoz Escomez. "Hail!" said the eldest, "Daughter of the Sun, who hast all the brilliance of the diamond, the beauty of the iris, the wisdom of Confucius, and the sweetness of the honey! This silver thread foretells a terrible calamity in the empire. Know that Brahma has decreed--it horrifies me to say so!--that one of your imperial teeth will commence to ache."

57791-the-details-of-the-rocket-system.creator: Unknown

58967-the-procurator-of-judea.creator: Unknown
58967-the-procurator-of-judea.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. less in their brilliant company, when, one day, after dinner, feeling fit, he took it into his head to climb the hills which, covered with vines like devotees of Bacchus, overlook the waves of the sea.

arxiv-1907-10421.title: A graphical heuristic for reduction and partitioning of large datasets for scalable supervised training
arxiv-1907-10421.creator: SYSumedh Yadav, MBMathis Bode
arxiv-1907-10421.description: Abstract A scalable graphical method is presented for selecting, and partitioning datasets for the training phase of a classification task. For the heuristic, a clustering algorithm is required to get its computation cost in a reasonable proportion to the task itself.

arxiv-1911-06225.title: Location estimation for symmetric log-concave densities
arxiv-1911-06225.creator: Nilanjana Laha ??
arxiv-1911-06225.description: Abstract We revisit the problem of estimating the center of symmetry θ \theta of an unknown symmetric density f f . Although Stone 1975 , Van Eeden 1970 , and Sacks 1975 constructed adaptive estimators of θ \theta in this model, their estimators depend on tuning parameters.

arxiv-2101-08179.title: Reaching the sensitivity limit of a Sagnac gyroscope through linear regression analysis
arxiv-2101-08179.creator: Angela D.V. Di Virgilio, Umberto Giacomelli, Andrea Simonelli, Giuseppe Terreni, Andrea Basti, Nicolò Beverini, Giorgio Carelli, Donatella Ciampini, Francesco Fuso, Enrico Maccioni, Paolo Marsili, Carlo Altucci, Francesco Bajardi, Salvatore Capozziello, Raffaele Velotta, Alberto Porzio, Antonello Or
arxiv-2101-08179.description: Abstract The sensitivity to angular rotation of the top class Sagnac gyroscope GINGERINO is carefully investigated with standard statistical means, using 103 days of continuous operation and the available geodesic measurements of the Earth angular rotation rate. All features of the Earth rotation rate are correctly reproduced. The sensitivity of fractions of frad/s is attained for long term runs.

arxiv-2103-03086.title: A Multi-Modal Respiratory Disease Exacerbation Prediction Technique Based on a Novel Spatio-Temporal Machine Learning Architecture and Local Environmental Sensor Networks
arxiv-2103-03086.creator: Rohan Tan Bhowmik
arxiv-2103-03086.description: Abstract Chronic respiratory diseases, such as the chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and asthma, are a serious health crisis, affecting a large number of people globally and inflicting major costs on the economy. Current methods for assessing the progression of respiratory symptoms are either subjective and inaccurate, or complex and cumbersome, and do not incorporate environmental factors.

arxiv-2110-07697.title: A Two-layer Approach for Estimating Behind-the-Meter PV Generation Using Smart Meter Data
arxiv-2110-07697.creator: Fankun Bu, Rui Cheng, Zhaoyu Wang
arxiv-2110-07697.description: Abstract As the cost of the residential solar system decreases, rooftop photovoltaic (PV) has been widely integrated into distribution systems. Most rooftop PV systems are installed behind-the-meter (BTM), i.e., only the net demand is metered, while the native demand and PV generation are not separately recorded.

arxiv-2111-03182.title: Forward silicon vertex/tracking detector design and R & \& D for the future Electron-Ion Collider
arxiv-2111-03182.creator: Walter Sondheim
arxiv-2111-03182.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Walter Sondheim. The proposed high-luminosity high-energy Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) will provide a clean environment to precisely study several fundamental questions in the fields of high-energy and nuclear physics . A low material budget and high granularity silicon vertex/tracking detector is critical to carry out a series of hadron and jet measurements at the future EIC especially for the heavy flavor product reconstruction or tagging.

arxiv-2207-07830.title: Profit Maximization using Social Networks in Two - Phase Setting Thanks: The work of Dr. Suman Banerjee is supported by the Start Up Grant provided by the Indian Institute of Technology Jammu, India (Grant No.: SG100047).
arxiv-2207-07830.creator: Poonam Sharma, Suman Banerjee
arxiv-2207-07830.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Poonam Sharma, Suman Banerjee. Now-a-days, Online Social Networks have been predominantly used by commercial houses for viral marketing where the goal is to maximize profit. In this paper, we study the problem of Profit Maximization in the two - phase setting. The input to the problem is a social network where the users are associated with a cost and benefit value, and a fixed amount of budget splitted into two parts.

arxiv-2211-02043.title: Could Giant Pretrained Image Models Extract Universal Representations?
arxiv-2211-02043.creator: Yutong Lin, Ze Liu, Zheng Zhang, Han Hu, Nanning Zheng, Stephen Lin, Yue Cao
arxiv-2211-02043.description: Abstract Frozen pretrained models have become a viable alternative to the pretraining-then-finetuning paradigm for transfer learning. However, with frozen models there are relatively few parameters available for adapting to downstream tasks, which is problematic in computer vision where tasks vary significantly in input/output format and the type of information that is of value.

arxiv-2401-09069.title: Accelerating HEP simulations with Neural Importance Sampling
arxiv-2401-09069.creator: Nicolas Deutschmann 1, Niklas Götz 2,3
arxiv-2401-09069.description: Abstract Many high-energy-physics (HEP) simulations for the LHC rely on Monte Carlo using importance sampling by means of the VEGAS algorithm. However, complex high-precision calculations have become a challenge for the standard toolbox, as this approach suffers from poor performance in complex cases.

arxiv-2502-01243.title: OphthBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Chinese Ophthalmology
arxiv-2502-01243.creator: Chengfeng Zhou, Ji Wang, Juanjuan Qin, Yining Wang, Ling Sun, Weiwei Dai
arxiv-2502-01243.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have shown significant promise across various medical applications, with ophthalmology being a notable area of focus. Many ophthalmic tasks have shown substantial improvement through the integration of LLMs. However, before these models can be widely adopted in clinical practice, evaluating their capabilities and identifying their limitations is crucial.

arxiv-2504-07034.title: Low Regularity of Self-Similar Solutions of Two-Dimensional Riemann Problems with Shocks for the Isentropic Euler System
arxiv-2504-07034.creator: Gui-Qiang G. Chen, Mikhail Feldman, Wei Xiang
arxiv-2504-07034.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gui-Qiang G. Chen, Mikhail Feldman, Wei Xiang. We are concerned with the low regularity of self-similar solutions of two-dimensional Riemann problems for the isentropic Euler system. We establish a general framework for the analysis of the local regularity of such solutions for a class of two-dimensional Riemann problems for the isentropic Euler system, which includes the regular shock reflection problem, the Prandtl reflection problem, the Lighthill diffraction problem, and the four-shock Riemann problem.

arxiv-2506-06596.title: EV-LayerSegNet: Self-supervised Motion Segmentation using Event Cameras
arxiv-2506-06596.creator: Youssef Farah, Federico Paredes-Vallés, Guido C.H.E. De Croon, Muhammad Ahmed Humais, Hussain Sajwani, Yahya Zweiri
arxiv-2506-06596.description: Abstract Event cameras are novel bio-inspired sensors that capture motion dynamics with much higher temporal resolution than traditional cameras, since pixels react asynchronously to brightness changes. They are therefore better suited for tasks involving motion such as motion segmentation. However, training event-based networks still represents a difficult challenge, as obtaining ground truth is very expensive, error-prone and limited in frequency.

arxiv-2508-12379.title: GraphCogent: Overcoming LLMs’ Working Memory Constraints via Multi-Agent Collaboration in Complex Graph Understanding
arxiv-2508-12379.creator: Rongzheng Wang, Qizhi Chen, Yihong Huang, Yizhuo Ma, Muquan Li, Jiakai Li, Ke Qin, Guangchun Luo, Shuang Liang
arxiv-2508-12379.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rongzheng Wang, Qizhi Chen, Yihong Huang, Yizhuo Ma, Muquan Li, Jiakai Li, Ke Qin, Guangchun Luo, Shuang Liang. Large language models (LLMs) show promising performance on small-scale graph reasoning tasks but fail when handling real-world graphs with complex queries. This phenomenon stems from LLMs’ inability to effectively process complex graph topology and perform multi-step reasoning simultaneously.

arxiv-2601-06303.title: The pros and cons of using deep reinforcement learning or genetic algorithms to design control schemes for quantum state transfer on qubit chains
arxiv-2601-06303.creator: Sofía Perón Santana (1) (2), Ariel Fiuri (1), Martín Domínguez (1), Omar Osenda (1) (2)
arxiv-2601-06303.description: Abstract In recent years, control methods based on different optimization techniques have shed light on the possibilities of processing information in many quantum systems. When exploring the transmission of quantum states, faster transmission times are mandatory to avoid the deleterious effects of multiple sources of decoherence that spoil the transmission process.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-st-rosalia.description: Article 'St. Rosalia' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

europmc-pmc5627926.title: Physical, psychological and occupational consequences of job burnout: A systematic review of prospective studies.
europmc-pmc5627926.creator: Salvagioni DAJ, Melanda FN, Mesas AE, González AD, Gabani FL, Andrade SM.
europmc-pmc5627926.description: Burnout is a syndrome that results from chronic stress at work, with several consequences to workers' well-being and health. This systematic review aimed to summarize the evidence of the physical, psychological and occupational consequences of job burnout in prospective studies.

europmc-pmc7803748.title: Mechanisms of muscle atrophy and hypertrophy: implications in health and disease.
europmc-pmc7803748.creator: Sartori R, Romanello V, Sandri M.
europmc-pmc7803748.description: Skeletal muscle is the protein reservoir of our body and an important regulator of glucose and lipid homeostasis. Consequently, the growth or the loss of muscle mass can influence general metabolism, locomotion, eating and respiration. Therefore, it is not surprising that...

pmc-10568475.title: Case report: A community case study of the human-animal bond in animal-assisted therapy: the experiences of psychiatric prisoners with therapy dogs
pmc-10568475.creator: Sonia Smith, Colleen Anne Dell, Tim Claypool, Darlene Chalmers, Aliya Khalid
pmc-10568475.description: Prisoners frequently experience chronic loneliness and lack social support, which can exacerbate their struggles with incarceration. According to attachment theory, individuals who are insecurely attached may be more likely to develop unstable relationships and engage in antisocial behavior as adults.

pmc-10687969.title: Structure–activity relationships andz interindividual variability of drug responses: pharmacogenomics with antimicrobial drugs as a paradigm
pmc-10687969.creator: Romany H. Thabet, Bayan Osama Shehadeh Alshar, Doaa Habes Saleh Alabdallah, Nour Alhuda Zaid Ahmad Alhmoud, Sondos Taher Abdalsalam Alslameen, Youssef Romany Helmy Thabet
pmc-10687969.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Adverse drug reactions represent a major health burden because they cause notable patient morbidity and mortality. From this viewpoint, several strategies have been developed to prevent or reduce adverse drug reactions. One such strategy is the use of pharmacogenomics. Interindividual variability in drug response and adverse effects is mainly attributable to genetic variation in enzymes such as sulfotransferases and cytochrome P450s. The current narrative review discusses the relationship between the structure and activity of drugs.

pmc-11326012.title: Research hotspots and frontiers of neoadjuvant therapy in triple-negative breast cancer: a bibliometric analysis of publications between 2002 and 2023
pmc-11326012.creator: Chuang Yang, Hui Liu, Xing Feng, Han Shi, Yuchan Jiang, Junfeng Li, Jinxiang Tan
pmc-11326012.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is a highly aggressive type of breast cancer with poor prognosis, and neoadjuvant therapy (NAT) has emerged as an important component in managing advanced-stage patients by providing surgical opportunities and improving survival outcomes. A search of publications on NAT for TNBC from 2002 to 2023 was conducted through the Web of Science core collection.

pmc-12522655.title: ApoJ and apoL1 as novel determinants of MASH: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12522655.creator: Zichun Cai, Souad Najib, María A Núñez-Sánchez, María A Martínez-Sánchez, Carmen García-Melgares, Nathalie Viguerie, Joana Rossell, Josep Julve, Mikaël Croyal, Arsênio Rodrigues Oliveira, Carlos M Martínez, Sébastien J Dumas, Annelise Genoux, María D Frutos, Bruno Ramos-Molina, Laurent O Martinez
pmc-12522655.description: BackgroundPlasma apolipoproteins are linked to cardiometabolic dysfunctions, but their potential as biomarkers for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) remains underexplored.MethodsPlasma levels of 14 apolipoproteins (apoA-I, A-II, A-IV, B100, C-I, C-II, C-III, D, E, F, H, J, L1, M) were quantified using liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry in a cross-sectional study of 148 individuals with obesity undergoing bariatric surgery.

pmc-12538472.title: Reveal the differences in flavor of five varieties of black teas via sensory evaluation, UPLC, and GC × GC-QTOFMS approaches
pmc-12538472.creator: Mengcong Zhang, Xiaoshuang Lu, Peidi Zhang, Guangcai Li, Dongfang Li, Han Xie, Jian'’an Huang, Sheng Zhang, Zhonghua Liu, Ailing Liu
pmc-12538472.description: Commercial black teas vary widely, yet the formation mechanisms of their distinct flavors remain unclear. Here, five different varieties of black teas with medium commercial quality were collected and characterized by integrating flavoromics and chemometric approaches. Soluble sugar, gallocatechin gallate, free amino acids, caffeine, and flavonoids were identified as characteristic taste components.

pmc-12665552.title: Gamma knife radiosurgery for cerebral cavernous malformations: biologically effective dose predicts therapeutic outcomes
pmc-12665552.creator: Xiaoman Shi, Hao Deng, Yang Wu, Yuan Gao, Xinyuejia Huang, Senlin Yin, Wei Wang
pmc-12665552.description: BackgroundGamma knife radiosurgery (GKRS) is an established option for cerebral cavernous malformations (CCMs) when microsurgical resection is not feasible. Lesion location strongly influences treatment strategy. The biologically effective dose (BED), introduced by J. F. Fowler, has been widely discussed in radiobiology but not evaluated in CCMs.

pmc-13049144.title: Turning precision medicine into reality with statistics and data-driven decision making across pharmaceutical development
pmc-13049144.creator: Guillaume Desachy, Karl Köchert, Nicole Krämer, René Kubiak, Biomarkers European Special Interest Group
pmc-13049144.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Ten years after the launch of the Precision Medicine Initiative, its broader impact remains uncertain beyond select genetic and oncological cases. Here, we share our perspective as pharmaceutical statisticians and propose strategic shifts to realize its full potential.Subject terms: Biomarkers, Drug development, Clinical trial design, Biomarkers Introduction Precision medicine has emerged as a transformative approach in drug development, offering the promise of tailored therapies that address the unique needs of specific patient populations.

pmc-13173133.title: 393 A bone to pick: morphometric characterization of black bone MRI toward clinical implementation
pmc-13173133.creator: Natalie West, Samuel Mulder, Lucas McCullum, Travis Salzillo, Renjie He, Yao Ding, Jihong Wang, Komal Shah, Kim Learned, Melissa Chen, Stephen Y Lai, Clifton D Fuller
pmc-13173133.description: Objectives/Goals: Conventional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) methods are unable to visualize bone comparable to computed tomography (CT). Radiation therapy can result in post-treatment complications, such as osteoradionecrosis (ORN). We aim to integrate black bone (BB) MRI into routine follow-up MRI scans as an alternative to CT to monitor the development of ORN.

pmc-13253295.title: Dual role of N4BP1 in neutrophil–epithelial crosstalk in periodontitis
pmc-13253295.creator: Yuqiang Sun, ZiHan Shen, Wenyu Zhen, Fei Xu, Yutong Lu, Yufei Pan, Dawei Mi, Shouzheng Ma, Wei Li, Wansu Sun, Jintao Yu, Hengguo Zhang
pmc-13253295.description: BackgroundPeriodontitis is a chronic inflammatory disease driven by immune dysregulation, in which neutrophils play a central but functionally heterogeneous role. The contributions of specific neutrophil subsets to disease pathogenesis remain poorly defined.MethodsWe integrated single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and Mendelian randomization analysis to identify disease-associated immune cell subsets and gene regulatory mechanisms.

pmc-13265218.title: Identification of prognostic immune-related genes and evaluation of chemotherapy and immunotherapy responses in pancreatic cancer
pmc-13265218.creator: Yang Yang, Haodong Tang, Jiahua Zhou
pmc-13265218.description: BackgroundPancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by a dense extracellular matrix and a complex tumor microenvironment, which contribute to poor prognosis and limited response to anti-tumor therapies. Although immunotherapy has emerged as a promising strategy, only a subset of patients derives clinical benefit. Therefore, identifying reliable biomarkers to predict prognosis and therapeutic response remains an urgent need.

pmc-13670858.title: Knowledge, attitudes, and perceptions of organ donation among medical university students in Armenia: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13670858.creator: Daniel Panossian, Rawad Affan, Georges Jarrouge, Sahag Panossian, Shafika Assaad
pmc-13670858.description: BackgroundOrgan donation is essential for patients with end-stage organ failure, yet transplantation systems remain limited by organ shortages, public awareness, ethical concerns, and trust in healthcare systems.ObjectivesThis study aimed to assess knowledge, attitudes, and perceptions of organ donation among medical university students in Armenia.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted among 700 medical university students in Armenia during the 2025–2026 academic year.

uslaw-usc-t15-s15b.title: 15 U.S.C. § 15b — Limitation of actions
uslaw-usc-t15-s15b.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s15b.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 1 (Monopolies And Combinations In Restraint Of Trade). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any action to enforce any cause of action under section 15, 15a, or 15c of this title shall be forever barred unless commenced within four years after the cause of action accrued. No cause of action barred under existing law.
